description: Watch the rivers, canals and coasts of Germany from a workflow, with the federal waterways' own gauges. Find gauges on the Rhine, Elbe, Danube and about 100 other waters, read the latest water level, discharge or temperature at one gauge or along a whole river, get up to 31 days of readings with a summary and a chart, compare a level with the gauge's mean and record levels, and read the water level forecasts, the daily readings for shipping and the fairway depths on the Elbe and Oder. Start a workflow when a reading rises above or falls below a mark. No account or API key required.
